title: Cloud cost reading checklist
summary: Cost optimization starts by understanding the billing unit and actual utilization.

blocks.text: Cost optimization starts by understanding the billing unit and actual utilization.

items: Identify whether cost is driven by compute time, capacity, storage, requests, egress or reserved resources.
Idle always-on compute is a different problem from inefficient queries.
Tag/label resources so costs can be assigned to projects/environments.
Optimize after measuring; the cheapest architecture on paper can be operationally expensive.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
